price_snapshot_note: price_observed fields are archival snapshots dated 2026-11-19. Observation time and delivery location were not recorded; prices are not current offers. See FLG-012.
claim_basis: Specs, ratings, and prices are seller/listing statements from the snapshot. Claim-marked fields (accuracy, certification, response time, heat-safe ratings, function names) are marketing claims the site has not tested. See FLG-009.
citation_policy: Every value rendered on the site must trace to one of: (a) a dated fetch of the official listing, (b) a dated fetch of an official policy page, or (c) arithmetic over (a) that states its inputs. Values with no such trace are left blank and published on flagged.html. See data/citations.json.
live_recheck_note: Three dated observations now exist for the five supplied links: 2026-11-19 (all five read as /dp/ product pages), 2026-11-20 session 70e8475c (B04G1MEwY homepage, four product pages), 2026-11-20 session ce911db5 (B04G1MEwY and B0c8moW59 homepage, three product pages), and 2026-11-20 session 6bf60cac/T-46 (all five homepage). No record is merged into another. See FLG-017, FLG-031 and FLG-025.
observation_note: Three dated observations of the supplied links exist for 2026-11-20 and they do not agree. Nothing is deleted and no record outranks another. A fetch cannot establish what a signed-in reader sees, so only the owner's click-through inside the enrolled Associates workflow (Q-02 + Q-22) settles the question. No observation here is evidence that the links are invalid.

link_policy_2026_11_20.decision: Every reader-facing product button points at https://www.amazon.com/dp/<observed ASIN>?tag=shopnow047c-20&linkCode=sl1 — 30 buttons across the front page, both category shelves, the comparison table, the gift guide and the five generated product pages. None uses a link.amazon short link and none is untagged.
link_policy_2026_11_20.basis: Program Policies, Participation Requirements 2(a) (S37) and 2(b); Commission Income Statement 2(g) (S38) and 2(e) (S38). Observed 2026-11-20: no short link delivered a URL carrying a tag, and all five delivered the Amazon homepage.
link_policy_2026_11_20.limits: A fetch from outside the account cannot see whether Amazon attaches a tag server-side, and cannot confirm the tracking ID belongs to an eligible enrolled account (FLG-010). The owner test (FLG-006, Q-02, Q-22) settles both.
link_policy_2026_11_20.gates: scripts/check_site.py rule 7b and tools/check_site.py P09 fail the build if a button loses its tag, loses its product target, or returns to a shortener. Both were negative-tested the same day: they named two untagged hand-written buttons and five untagged generated pages before the fix.
